verdict: Design suitable for a narrow implementation brief, conditional on the contracts and offline gates below. No implementation or performance acceptance.

nonGoals: No Family names, protocol math, ABI/layout knowledge, or new interfaces in central code
No source checks, search amounts, candidate quality, budgets, deadlines or configuration changes
No Rust prefix, prefetch, continuation, cohort batching or V4 Family work
No implementation, runtime tests, network or credential access during this review

limitations: Derived local empty N, not canonical N end-state; no full canonical state-root equivalence claimed.

currentCodeAnchors.finding: Cache is runtime-local. assertCurrent checks work control, generation and prefix source and retires the relevant lifetime on failure. Prefix-context requests never enter rethBound.

Only get-code reserves a raw-byte shared owner/joiner before the direct group queues. Independent storage still issues provider work. Joiners do not hold another group's physical permit; awaitAllDrained retains ownership.
Existing cache binds source number/hash/generation, lane, address, original signal identity and exact safe-integer deadline; bounded256-entry LRU with nonretained overflow and rejection eviction.
Prefix simulation takes precedence over raw source transports. Code optionally consumes a shared promise; storage unconditionally calls provider.getStorage through withRpcRetry.
Each logical request has an independent completion fence; final result array preserves request order and has a final fence.
Storage requests already require an address and exactly32-byte hex slot.
Current default xWin exact declares source reads, builds dependent local preparation, then decodes into a local trial quote; explicit simulation mode is not used.
Initial xWin source wave includes the fund implementation storage slot.

xwinLocalRound takes surface, executor, completedRound and prior results, not amount. Storage appears in completedRound0 (base amount, swap implementation/oracle),1 (token implementation/admin, swap admin, oracle implementations),2 (oracle admins); round3 has no storage. Initial plus these rounds are four successive storage-bearing waves.

evidence.interpretation: Current code exposes repeated amount-independent raw source reads that can be deduplicated generically. The saved successful control establishes12 first-hop request-program executions plus12 local second hops, not storage request counts, physical envelopes or storage-attributed wait. Its17.641s Solver wall time is historical total only and must not be attributed to get-storage.
evidence.unproven: The saved hop/result artifacts do not bind per-read signal/deadline identity, cache hitability, storage timings or eviction pressure. Actual retained hits across production-shaped amount trials must be demonstrated offline before assuming any latency benefit.

minimalContract: Generalize only the existing private raw-read cache and owner/joiner plumbing to code and storage. Keep one combined256-entry map, not a second256-entry storage cache.

Key raw storage by source number+lowercase hash+generation, lane, request kind, lowercase address, lowercase canonical32-byte slot, original AbortSignal identity and exact deadlineAtMs. Code must retain its own kind with no slot ambiguity. Provider identity is implicit in the bound runtime; separate runtimes never share.

Share only with the existing explicit signal plus safe-integer finite deadline eligibility. No signal normalization, implicit controls or lifetime expansion. Aborted/expired/retired requests are fenced before reuse. Missing/partial/nonfinite control retains direct reads.

Reserve only non-prefix directReth code/storage requests before scheduling. exactPrefixContext must bypass both reservation and source-cache consumption, regardless of available cached source bytes. Do not reuse mutated execution state or simulation results.

Owner performs the unchanged provider operation and bounded retry with existing controls and before/after source fences. Joiners and completed hits still execute their own runRequest, issueResult, provenance, source snapshots and final fencing. Never share issued result/evidence handles or bypass required/optional result-set validation or Family decode.

Retain successful storage bytes only when exactly32-byte hexadecimal; all-zero words are valid raw bytes, not proof of Family eligibility. Preserve the original returned bytes and current result/error classification; do not pad, truncate, normalize values, manufacture zeros or turn malformed values into accepted proofs. Malformed bytes may reach their original logical consumers but must not be retained for later reuse.

Failure, abort, deadline and generation retirement remove reuse without cancelling unrelated work. Pending completions must not repopulate retired/overflow entries. Preserve code's32KiB retention bound, combined cap, LRU and all-pending overflow behavior.

Preserve one permit for each actual direct physical group, no permit for a pure cache join/hit, no nested acquisition, and release physical group ownership before awaiting other owners. Batch eth_calls remain concurrently queued and independently drained.

Keep logical request budgets, order and source/result checks intact. Existing rethCalls diagnostic is a logical count, not physical RPCs; do not present a reduced provider count as reduced logical validation.

requiredTests.expect: Canonical storage word, same key/control: concurrent pending joins and sequential completed hits issue one provider read; ordered fresh result objects and independently bound provenance/IDs per request. Different amount/program metadata must not change raw key or reuse logical handles.

Request kind, address, slot, source number/hash/generation, lane, signal, exact deadline and runtime/provider separately prevent in-flight and completed reuse. Hex case variants of canonical address/slot may share.

Change storage-unshared expectation only for explicit-controlled requests with canonical32-byte response. For two identical controlled mixed groups expect one code and one read per distinct storage slot, one physical owner group; assert logical result order/count unchanged. Retain separate none/signal-only/deadline-only/nonfinite cases with direct storage and original per-group permits. The old0x00 mock is not a valid retained word; do not broaden acceptance merely to make this test pass.

Warm a base-source storage cache, then issue identical slots through withExactPrefix; simulator returns different mutated bytes per prefix. Every prefix read must call simulatePrefix, no source provider/cache reuse, and no pollution of a later base-source hit. Missing simulator/source mismatch stays fail-closed.

Shared physical bounded retry, no rejected promise retained, required failure blocks decode, optional failure remains optional per consumer. Short/odd/invalid/oversized storage never retained; all-zero canonical storage retained but every consumer's semantic guard still executes.

Pending and completed abort/deadline/generation failures fence every waiter and retire cache. Queued cancellation affects only that control domain. Sync/async permit failure settles every reservation and drains concurrent eth_call work. Mixed owner/joiner cannot deadlock or hold a permit while waiting on another owner.
Mixed code+storage entries share one256 cap; LRU eviction, pending overflow and no late repopulation. Existing code shape/retention and producer/discovery bypass cases remain intact.

Under later implementation authority, compare ordinary runtime executions using fixed-source loopback/mock reads through dependent programs and per-amount logical consumers. Require identical outputs/provenance semantics and all source fences with strictly fewer duplicate getStorage calls only when controls match; different controls retain calls. Full existing strictcentral and prefix/client regressions. Not executed in this design review.

benefitAndRisk.plausibleBenefit: After the first source load, repeated amount trials can avoid identical raw slot fetches and corresponding direct-group queue/wait where no other physical reads remain. Dependent round order and all eth_call work remain; not all four round waits necessarily disappear.
benefitAndRisk.measuredBenefit: Unknown. No storage-attributed timing or actual physical reduction is established by the old positive result alone.
tradeoffs: Shared256-entry pressure may evict code earlier; do not increase cap to hide this.
A cached source value must never stand in for post-prefix state.
Success sharing deliberately reduces repeated transport attempts, not logical checks; failed/malformed outcomes cannot become durable cache entries.
Same signal/deadline is essential; do not loosen identity to manufacture reuse.
benefitAndRisk.futureWorkload: Saved xWin rank1 is a local-repeat control, not Rust-prefix workload. Its parent-state-with-N-environment source is synthetic and root is zero; any later experiment must preserve that environment rather than remap to canonical external RPC.
benefitAndRisk.acceptance: Proceed only to a separately authorized narrow implementation and offline proof. Any later latency claim needs a frozen same-input comparison and physical-call attribution; no live/systemic win follows from this review.

ranGate: Read current plan, central runtime cache/dispatch/fences, existing code-share contract tests, storage request validation and xWin request builders.
